My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
If your tracking shows delivered but you haven’t received the package, here’s what we recommend:



Wait up to 24 hours — FedEx can sometimes mark a package as delivered before it actually arrives.


Check around the delivery location — look around doors, porches, mail areas, leasing offices, and ask household members or neighbors.


Review the master tracking link in your shipping confirmation email in case the order was split into multiple shipments.


If it’s still missing 24 hours after it was marked delivered, contact us so we can start a carrier trace.



A few important policy details:
- The trace takes about 2 business days to complete.
- You must contact us within 5 days of the package being marked delivered for us to start the trace.
- Packages reported as lost 2 weeks after the delivery date are not eligible for replacement.
- If the carrier cannot recover and redeliver it, we can send a one-time replacement.
- We’re not able to issue refunds for orders that show as delivered.
If you want, I can also help with what information to have ready before reaching out to us.
